question: What is the major product when ethanol reacts with potassium dichromate (K₂Cr₂O₇) in an acidic medium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethanoic acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• When ethanol (C2H5OH) reacts with potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) in an acidic medium, it undergoes oxidation.
 
• Potassium dichromate in the presence of acid acts as a strong oxidizing agent.
 
• The primary alcohol ethanol is first oxidized to ethanal (acetaldehyde), which is further oxidized to ethanoic acid (acetic acid).
 
• This two-step oxidation process results in the formation of ethanoic acid as the major product.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ethanol (C2H5OH):**

 
 
• Ethanol, commonly known as alcohol, is a volatile, flammable, colorless liquid with a slight characteristic odor.
 
• It is used in alcoholic beverages, as a solvent, and as a fuel.
 
 
 
• **Potassium Dichromate (K2Cr2O7):**
 
 
• Potassium dichromate is a common inorganic chemical reagent, mostly used as an oxidizing agent in various laboratory and industrial applications.
 
• In the presence of acid, it acts as a strong oxidizing agent and can oxidize primary alcohols to carboxylic acids.
 
 
 
• **Oxidation Reactions:**
 
 
• Oxidation involves the loss of electrons or an increase in the oxidation state of a molecule, atom, or ion.
 
• In organic chemistry, oxidation often involves the addition of oxygen to a compound or the removal of hydrogen.
 
 
 
• **Ethanoic Acid (CH3COOH):**
 
 
• Ethanoic acid, also known as acetic acid, is a colorless liquid organic compound with the chemical formula CH3COOH.
 
• It is the main component of vinegar and has a distinctive sour taste and pungent smell.
 
• Ethanoic acid is widely used in the production of synthetic fibers, plastics, food additives, and as a chemical reagent in laboratories.
 
 

The correct answer is **Option 2**__.
